raw_segments.text: All a kind of attempt to talk. Unpleasant when it stops because you never know exact.
Organ in Gardiner Street. Old Glen Fifty quit a year. Queer up there in the cockloft, alone
with stops and locks and keys. Seated all day at the organ. Monder on for hours, talking
to himself or the other fellow blowing the bellows. Growl angry, then shriek cursing.
Want to have wadding or something in his no don'ts, she cried. Then all of a soft, sudden
wee little wee little pipey wind.
